styles.how: Ported from a measured reference. styles.label: Word behind head
styles.best_for: The keyword in huge glowing caps behind the speaker's head, plain captions lower down.
styles.source: Pinterest 'AREN'T BORING' (4 Visual Hooks for Social Media); Tommy's Pin 4.8 s 'content'; REFERENCE-SPEC.md H2
styles.how: Each starred word gets its own line (two lines max, the 'AREN'T / BORING' stack), heavy caps (Archivo Black on VIDPOD, brand bold otherwise), tracking -0.02em, line pitch 1.3x cap height, widest line fitted to 920 px. The head (base.face.hook_top or top) covers the lower 55 % of the last line's caps. Fill in the picked colour with a three-step glow of the same colour (0.05em at 90 %, 0.2em at 55 %, 0.55em at 28 %). Each line lands on its spoken word: opacity 0 to 1, scale 1.07 to 1, blur 6 to 0 px over 0.32 s expo.out; the stack drifts 1 to 1.03 linear; a new hook line swaps the stack (0.14 s fade). Captions: the spoken words, lowercase, brand bold 84 px white with a soft shadow, centred at y 1330, three words at a time, each word on its timestamp. Headroom: if the clip is framed too tight for the layout, the plate and its person matte move down together by the amount needed (max 420 px) for the whole hook; the gap above is the plate's top rows above the head, flipped and stretched, blur 3 px. It eases back over 0.5 s power2.inOut, starting 0.55 s before the hook ends.

The keyword's glyphs are measured: lead words go top left, sitting down into the ascender zone over a run of x-height letters when one is wide enough (else their baseline kisses the cap line); more lead words (or long follow words) go top right the same way; follow words go under the right end where there are no descenders. Rows that would touch step a line up (above) or down (below). styles.label: Glow title, pull-back
styles.best_for: A two-line headline that glows in your colour while the whole shot pulls back. Up from the first frame, then your subtitles take over.
styles.source: Measured reference (internal): frame-by-frame fit of a finance Short's opener
styles.how: Two lines in heavy caps (Archivo Black on VIDPOD, the brand bold elsewhere): a near-white setup line (8.02 % of frame width, 87 px) over a punch line in the brand colour (9.28 %, 100 px), each shrunk only past 80 % of the frame width; line boxes hug the caps, gap 0.07x the punch size; block centred at y 1114 (58 %). Fills: setup white tinted 3 to 9 % toward the brand colour, top to baseline; punch the brand colour 3 % lighter at the cap top, 6 % darker at 68 %, 13 % darker at the baseline. Glow under both lines: 0.15em at 0.2, 1.1em at 0.6, 2.2em at 0.6 (setup) or 0.25 (punch). Dark grade under it (clear at 30 % of the height to 0.92 at the bottom, x 0.8), in over 0.3 s. Camera: the footage AND the title scale 1.25 to 1 on 1 + 0.0463 e^(-t/0.07 s) + 0.2038 e^(-t/1.11 s) about (50 %, 31.6 %), settled by 6 s; a few px of zoom blur on frames 1 to 4 only. Tracking +0.035em to 0 on the same curve. Title opacity 1 - e^(-t/0.17 s) from frame 0 (28 % on the first frame, solid by 0.65 s). Holds 3 to 5 s (to the first phrase start in that range, else 4 s), fades out over the last 0.25 s, grade over 0.3 s; the camera keeps settling and the house subtitles take over. The words are a headline about the topic (two lines: about 14 to 16 characters, then 10 to 12 ending in ?), not a quote.
